mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the threads to the platelet plug was the most worthwhile: it brought the two parts together and showed how the leak stopped.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the cut was predictable from the intro and the only offered combination at that point, though it set up the repair.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the damaged vessel narrowed but continued leaking, and that the skin remained open after bleeding stopped.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless: the labels and pictures explained the pairings. Most choices after the first were the only offered combination, though, so they did not require much decision-making.

continue.text: I would choose to continue to see how the still-open skin heals. The distinction between plugging a vessel and repairing skin gave me a reason to be curious.
